book.name: 2 Corinth
book.title: Paul Secon Letta Ta Dem Een Corinth

content: We know dat ef dis tent we lib een, we body yah een dis wol, git stroy, God got a place fa we fa lib een heaben. Dat a house wa God mek wa gwine las faeba.
Fa true, wiles we da lib yah, we da groan, cause we wahn fa pit on we nyew cloes. We wahn fa be eenside we house een heaben.
Cause wen we dey eenside we house een heaben, we ain neba gwine be dout nottin fa kiba we op.

Wiles we still da lib yah eenside dis tent, we da groan wid we hebby burden we da tote. Dat ain fa say dat we wahn fa come outta we body dat we got een dis wol. Bot we wahn God fa pit we house fom heaben pon we, so dat life wa gwine las faeba gwine swalla op we body yah wa gwine dead.
God de one wa done ready we fa dis nyew house, an e gii we e Holy Sperit fa show we dat.
So den, cause we know dem ting yah, we ain neba gii op. We know dat all de time dis body yah we house, we ain gone yet fa lib een de house dat God da keep fa we.
Cause we da waak coddin ta fait. We ain da waak jes by wa we da see wid we eye.
A da tell oona, we ain neba gii op. An fa sho, we wahn fa go way fom dis body an go lib wid de Lawd.
Bot weza we da lib een we body yah or way op een heaben, de ting we wahn mo den all, we wahn fa do dem ting wa gwine mek we Lawd sattify.
Cause we all gwine haffa stanop fo Christ jedgiment seat. E gwine jedge we, an ebrybody gwine git e payback fa e wok wen e been dey een dis life, weza e good or bad.
Christ Mek All Ting Right Twix God an We
So den, we know wa e mean fa be scaid ob de Lawd, so we da try fa taak ta people fa win um oba ta de Lawd. God know we shru an shru, an A hope dat oona ondastan we een oona haat too.

We ain da try fa tell oona gin dat we good. We da try fa gii oona good reason fa be heppy cause ob we. Den oona gwine be able fa ansa dem wa da brag bout wa people da do so dat oda people kin shim, steada bout wa dey eenside a poson haat.
Ef e look like we ain got no sense, den dat fa sake ob God, ainty? Ef oona bleebe we got sense, dat fa sake ob oona.
De lob ob Christ fa we da rule oba we, cause we know fa sho, dat one man done dead fa all people. An dat mean dat all people done dead wid um.
E done dead fa all, so dat dem wa got life mus dohn lib no mo fa deysef. Dey oughta jes lib fa de one wa done dead an wa God mek lib gin fa dey sake.
So we ain oughta jedge nobody no mo same like people da jedge um. Eben dough we beena jedge Christ like people da jedge oda people, we ain do dat no mo.
Wen somebody come fa be one wid Christ, e a nyew poson. De ole way ob life wa e beena lib done done. E da lib a nyew way ob life now.
God do all dis. Shru Jedus Christ, God mek all ting right twix esef an we. An e gii we de wok fa go tell oda people how dey kin come ta um an leh God mek all ting right twix God an dem.

Dat mean fa say dat God mek all ting right twix esef an people cause ob wa Christ done. God ain memba people sin ginst um no mo fa punish um. An e chaage we fa go tell people how e mek all ting right twix God an dem.
So den, Christ sen we fa tell oona dis. Wen we da taak ta oona, e like God esef da taak. Fa sake ob Christ, we da beg oona. Come ta God an leh um mek all ting right tween esef an oona.
Christ ain neba do no sin, bot fa we sake, God pit we sin dem pon Christ, so dat wen we come fa be one wid Christ, all ting come fa be right twix God an we.
